description: The primary visible action does nothing. The Buy now button is wired to a real click handler, and that handler calls placeOrder(), which returns nothing, creates nothing and raises no error.

required_outcomes.title: UI action: click handler on element in `public/app.js`
required_outcomes.why: the Buy now button's click binding is found. With no browser evidence it stays an inference, and an inference about a primary action must stay visible rather than be assumed fine.

required_outcomes.title: project contains placeholder usage in production code
required_outcomes.why: the handler body says in words that it is a placeholder and returns nothing.

required_outcomes.title: project contains TODO or FIXME comments in production code
required_outcomes.why: the unfinished work is marked with a TODO on the same function.
a first-time visitor presses this button; it must not be filed as style noise.

forbidden_outcomes.description: The Buy now button is reported as working, wired, implemented or passing. Pressing it creates no order.
The project aggregates to green while the primary action has no observable effect.
The existence of a click handler is treated as completion. A handler that does nothing is the defect, not the fix.
The placeholder body, the TODO and the unwired outcome are not reported at all.

notes: Severity gap, recorded rather than hidden: evaluation/acceptance-manifest.json requires must_fix; ui_action_bridge and candidate_scanner both emit Severity::Note, critical = false, EvidenceClass::Inference, which false_completion_aggregator::aggregate classifies as style_noise rather than material. Runtime browser evidence is what upgrades a UI action to ObservedFact, and this fixture does not require a browser. crates/sure-core/tests/adversarial_fixture_detection.rs asserts exactly these three proposals.
